verdict.rationale: Superset documents an official hosted MCP server for creating workspaces, launching agent sessions, scheduling automations, opening terminals, and managing tasks, and publishes a .well-known server card for it. A runtime probe confirmed the endpoint at api.superset.sh/mcp is live and returns the standard MCP OAuth challenge. Missing for 10: no authenticated end-to-end tool invocation or independent community report of agents actually using the MCP server.
